CFML Language Reference: Functions

Quarter

Returns which quarter of the calendar year a date falls in: January to March is 1, October to December is 4.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Quarter(date)

Parameters

date
A date/time value or a string that can be converted to one.

Returns

A number from 1 to 4.

Usage

Same as DatePart("q", date). Calendar quarters only; if your fiscal year starts in July, shift the date with DateAdd first.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFQUERY NAME="Hires" DATASOURCE="cfsnippets">
SELECT FirstName, LastName, StartDate FROM Employees ORDER BY StartDate
</CFQUERY>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Employee</TH><TH>Started</TH><TH>Quarter</TH></TR>
<CFOUTPUT QUERY="Hires" MAXROWS="8">
<TR><TD>#FirstName# #LastName#</TD><TD>#DateFormat(StartDate, "mmm d, yyyy")#</TD>
    <TD>Q#Quarter(StartDate)# #Year(StartDate)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</TABLE>
